reviews.title: 骗子软件
reviews.text: 上面显示是三天免费试用，结果一下载就扣了363，退款也被拒绝了 ，I was misled by the interface into an accidental subscription, losing 363 RMB. Apple refused a refund, and your response was just "we'll look into it" with no real action. If you can collect the payment, why not refund it? Please stop the runaround and solve this issue.
reviews.reply:
Hi again,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us!

We're truly sorry to hear how frustrating this situation has been. We understand how upsetting it is when a purchase doesn't happen as expected and you feel your concerns haven't been properly resolved 💫 Please note that all subscriptions on our platform are initiated and managed by users, but we never want anyone to feel left without support or clear answers.

If your case is still unresolved, we'd sincerely appreciate the opportunity to review it again. Please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com, and our team will take another careful look at the details to provide the best possible assistance.

Holding space for your journey,
Nebula

reviews.title: 骗子软件（邮件沟通后）
reviews.text: 4点的时候被他们软件的订阅页面误导，4点05就申通退款了，苹果拒绝了，联系了这个软件的负责人，他们推给苹果，这笔钱又不是给苹果的，苹果就是一个“桥梁”，他们不想退都不敢直接说，就说只能苹果才能退款，而且我们他们的退费条例里说，如果是欧洲居民，邮件申请他们可以直接退，然后我们这边邮件各种沟通都不给退，不知道是不是歧视。而且就算服了一年的订阅，里面的一些功能还是要收费。真的很不推荐。最后！他们的订阅页面真的很容易被误导！！！估计就是靠这招骗钱的。也别信他们说可以联系他们邮件沟通什么的，就是一直踢皮球。
reviews.reply:
Hi,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience — we truly appreciate your feedback.

We’re sorry to hear this felt frustrating, and that’s definitely not the experience we want for our users.
We’d really like to look into this and help — please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com so we can assist you directly.

With gratitude, 
Nebula
